verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's full-height colour stripes and white card. The stripes become two small stubby bars plus a stray grey slab, and the vertical URL shrinks to illegible micro-text (top-centre in A, wedged between the bars in B). 'for all drinkware on' is disconnected from $49.99. B is worse: 'WINE GLASSES' wraps into 'WINE / GLASSES', which reads as two separate list items and breaks the product list. A keeps the five-item list intact.
